rules.description: All locale JSON files must have identical key trees — no missing or extra keys
Interpolation variables ({{name}}) must be present in all language variants of a key
No translation value may be an empty string
TypeScript must type translation keys — no bare string indexing
A useTranslation hook or typed t() function must be exported
RTL locales (ar, he, fa) require dir=rtl handling in the layout
Components must use t('key') — no hardcoded display strings
